summary: Reference corrections made after the model runs, from an outside review and an audit of all 48 references against their questions' wording. The questions and every saved response are unchanged. A response is scored against the corrected reference, or, for questions listed under accepted_readings, against any one listed reading applied consistently on all nine databases. The counterfactual databases are regenerated by study/fuzz.py after one fix: new files under a tests/ folder are test files (the extractor's rule), which the original generator marked as non-test outside the top-level tests/ folder.

not_changed.reason: With multiple inheritance a class can reach ClickException along paths of different lengths; the reference reports the shortest, which is the natural reading of 'the number of inheritance steps between it and ClickException'.
Its only divergence came from the generator's test-file defect, fixed in the regenerated databases.
